kjn-p01-v1.quick_english: O goddess, knowledge is eighteen-fold in the kula sphere.

kjn-p01-v2.quick_english: The first chapter emerges from candra-dvīpa.

kjn-p01-v3.quick_english: Tell me the dissolution, since creation-yoga is known by me.

kjn-p01-v4.quick_english: Indeed, kālāgni-rudra is eternally situated at the tip of the nail.

kjn-p01-v5.quick_english: And the greatness of vaḍavāmukha is situated together in the netherworld.

kjn-p01-v6.quick_english: O fair one, these fourteen worlds have been told.

kjn-p01-v7.quick_english: All-knowing effort dissolves dissolution in the sphere of śakti.

kjn-p01-v8.quick_english: In knowledge action is dissolved; action dissolves in will.

kjn-p01-v9.quick_english: Indeed, this dissolution has been told to you, o beautiful one, by division.

kjn-p01-v10.quick_english: Thus creation-yoga, placed in positions, creates moving and unmoving things.

kjn-p01-v11.quick_english: O goddess, creation-yoga was previously indicated to you by me.

kjn-p01-v12.quick_english: O lord, why do you ask anything else when the very secret has been made manifest?

kjn-p01-v13.quick_english: The second chapter emerges from candra-dvīpa.

kjn-p01-v14.quick_english: This is my doubt, o lord; be gracious, o Śaṅkara.

kjn-p01-v15.quick_english: Where sight and mind are, there are elements, senses, and the individual.

kjn-p01-v16.quick_english: Place, meditation, color, and mark indeed form a tetrad.

kjn-p01-v17.quick_english: The mark designated with color-form is indeed devoid of form.

kjn-p01-v18.quick_english: O goddess, situated in place, for each one it is fourfold.

kjn-p01-v19.quick_english: O beloved, five-spoked, sixteen-spoked, and sixty-four-petaled.

kjn-p01-v20.quick_english: Listen otherwise: above that million-petaled, greatly splendid thing.

kjn-p01-v21.quick_english: Likewise, shining and endowed with pericarp and filaments.

kjn-p01-v22.quick_english: The autonomous lotus is immovable, all-pervading, and stainless.

kjn-p01-v23.quick_english: Indeed, by that the liṅga is celebrated, where moving and unmoving are dissolved.

kjn-p01-v24.quick_english: Without knowing, bondage is declared; having known, one is released from bonds.

kjn-p01-v25.quick_english: It is perceptible, always eternal, and resembles an atasī flower.

kjn-p02-v26.quick_english: The liṅga accessible to knowledge, always present, comes through traditional sequence.

kjn-p02-v27.quick_english: The true liṅga is not wood, clay, stone, or gem.

kjn-p02-v28.quick_english: Crystal, pearl, tin, lead, and copper-born forms are not the true liṅga.

kjn-p02-v29.quick_english: Eighteen world scriptures and spiritual ones are mentioned as cruel.

kjn-p02-v30.quick_english: O great goddess, why are bound souls devoid of knowledge?

kjn-p02-v31.quick_english: Do not associate with them for enjoyment, and do not accumulate wealth.

kjn-p02-v32.quick_english: Yakṣas, gandharvas, siddhas, grass, shrubs, and ants are listed.

kjn-p02-v33.quick_english: What has gone forth in the bindu middle becomes dissolved and equal to that.

kjn-p02-v34.quick_english: It vibrates, is stainless, eternal, immeasurable, and always proclaimed.

kjn-p02-v35.quick_english: Knowing and seeing this supreme liṅga makes one a partaker of liberation.

kjn-p02-v36.quick_english: The liṅga is not destroyed by fire and does not fall when struck by thunderbolt.

kjn-p02-v37.quick_english: Worship with mental flowers, fragrant offerings, incense, and lamps.

kjn-p02-v38.quick_english: The third is compassion-flower, devotion-flower is mentioned, and the fourth is indicated.

kjn-p02-v39.quick_english: The seventh is meditation-flower, knowledge-flower is mentioned, and the eighth is indicated.

kjn-p02-v40.quick_english: By worshipping the body-liṅga one obtains enjoyment and liberation.

kjn-p02-v41.quick_english: Always meditate on the mind-liṅga, which is equated with fruit.

kjn-p02-v42.quick_english: This, O kaulikā, is the characteristic of the body-liṅga.

kjn-p02-v43.quick_english: The worldly path, though endowed, is devoid of attainment and liberation.

kjn-p02-v44.quick_english: He whose latent impression is external is a bound soul, limb-colored.

kjn-p02-v45.quick_english: Give to one endowed with devotion, not to one devoid of devotion.

kjn-p02-v46.quick_english: The third chapter emerges in the candra island.

kjn-p02-v47.quick_english: Today, O Bhairava, grant me a stainless body by your grace.

kjn-p02-v48.quick_english: Restraint, grace, movement, and removal are listed together.

kjn-p02-v49.quick_english: How have I, in brief summary, taken refuge in you alone?

kjn-p02-v50.quick_english: Having drawn the kula-ball, together with channels and their mouths.

kjn-p03-v51.quick_english: Through the mouths of the channels, the repha-sound is illuminated below and above.

kjn-p03-v52.quick_english: Merged in the circle of birth is a splendor equal to both darkness and light.

kjn-p03-v53.quick_english: O auspicious one, one thus performs hand-praise and such acts with moving and unmoving beings.

kjn-p03-v54.quick_english: Merged in the circle of birth is a splendor equal to both darkness and light.

kjn-p03-v55.quick_english: Having meditated on the power in the form of a lightning creeper within the fivefold space.

kjn-p03-v56.quick_english: O great-minded one, through the piercing of power-knowledge, known as mental.

kjn-p03-v57.quick_english: The supreme power, having pervaded another body by sound, should pierce it.

kjn-p03-v58.quick_english: When asked, he will tell of the past and the future.

kjn-p03-v59.quick_english: O beloved, there is the knowledge of conch-consecration, tooth-stick, and so forth.

kjn-p03-v60.quick_english: O beloved, killing, uprooting, paralyzing, deluding, and so forth.

kjn-p03-v61.quick_english: O beloved, having known the combination of the fifty letters, do all.

kjn-p03-v62.quick_english: O goddess, one performs whatever various action is desired by the mind.

kjn-p03-v63.quick_english: Having known all and knowing the firm mark, one should indeed apply that stream of kula.

kjn-p03-v64.quick_english: That self-dependent one indeed attains liberation in the abode of all hearts.

kjn-p03-v65.quick_english: O auspicious one, what you asked about is the well-guarded cause of accomplishment.

kjn-p03-v66.quick_english: The kaula accomplishment should not be given to those devoid of devotion who desire it.

kjn-p03-v67.quick_english: The fourth chapter, emerged in the island of the moon, is concluded.

kjn-p03-v68.quick_english: O great god, tell the supreme destruction of delusion.

kjn-p03-v69.quick_english: He is freed from all duality and intent on what lies beyond practice.

kjn-p03-v70.quick_english: Arise: the sword, the netherworld, the yellow pigment, the collyrium, and the sandals.

kjn-p03-v71.quick_english: O goddess, invisibility may arise, and likewise another elixir.

kjn-p03-v72.quick_english: O beloved, listen with one-pointed mind to what is being told by me.

kjn-p03-v73.quick_english: Hear of the divine, moon-delighting one coming from the middle of the sky.

kjn-p03-v74.quick_english: For him there is no old age, no death, and no disease or illness.

kjn-p03-v75.quick_english: A white lotus expanse situated in the middle of the milk-ocean.

kjn-p05-v101.quick_english: It must be concealed with effort in the mortal world among the lowest men.

kjn-p05-v102.quick_english: It should be given to one previously accomplished and tested for one year.

kjn-p05-v103.quick_english: The fifth chapter emerged from candradīpa.

kjn-p05-v104.quick_english: By your grace, o lord of kaulas, I have known the determination of kaula.

kjn-p05-v105.quick_english: Who is that declared soul, or what is the nature of the soul?

kjn-p05-v106.quick_english: In what does dissolution go, and tell me all of that.

kjn-p05-v107.quick_english: He is supreme, partless, eternal, free from disease and stainless.

kjn-p05-v108.quick_english: That soul is supreme; indeed he is haṃsa, power-individual.

kjn-p05-v109.quick_english: Wind-filled air is situated in all beings.

kjn-p05-v110.quick_english: Upon merely leaving the body, he is called supreme śiva.

kjn-p05-v111.quick_english: Abiding in the ear, it is heard, o goddess, having come down through tradition.

kjn-p05-v112.quick_english: By this mere knowledge, heard, o fair-faced one.

kjn-p05-v113.quick_english: Who practices for six months in ochre robe becomes free from bondage.

kjn-p05-v114.quick_english: Freed from all diseases, he has union together with yogis.

kjn-p05-v115.quick_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.

kjn-p05-v116.quick_english: It should be given to one endowed with all states and of resolved mind.

kjn-p05-v117.quick_english: The kaula essence of yoginīs, of origin, should not be given.

kjn-p05-v118.quick_english: Today my pure body is struck by the veil of ignorance.

kjn-p05-v119.quick_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious deception of time.

kjn-p05-v120.quick_english: I tell you without doubt: thus death is destroyed.

kjn-p05-v121.quick_english: Even a wise person is burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of juice.

kjn-p05-v122.quick_english: Having placed air at the root of tongue and palate, one should drink it slowly.

kjn-p05-v123.quick_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.

kjn-p05-v124.quick_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one is bitten by great serpents.

kjn-p05-v125.quick_english: One who has gone to that state, with mind fixed on it, is not cut even while being cut.

kjn-p06-v126.quick_english: One should know that to be the nectar which destroys wrinkles and gray hair.

kjn-p06-v127.quick_english: One becomes freed from wrinkles and gray hair, and devoid of all diseases.

kjn-p06-v128.quick_english: One should apply the tongue at the root of the palate for the destruction of disease.

kjn-p06-v129.quick_english: One should always contract the tongue, keeping it joined within one's own mouth.

kjn-p06-v130.quick_english: Having placed the mind in the heart, one remains until the state of unmana is attained.

kjn-p06-v131.quick_english: O goddess, the well-guarded deception of time has now been made manifest.

kjn-p06-v132.quick_english: Thus ends the sixth chapter in the section emerging from the moon island.

kjn-p06-v133.quick_english: Tell me of the three principles, O lord; I have taken refuge in you alone.

kjn-p06-v134.quick_english: One should contemplate what is in the goddess's wheel, like the moon on the first day of the lunar fortnight.

kjn-p06-v135.quick_english: There indeed, O beautiful-faced one, the flame is absorbed in the wheel of bone.

kjn-p06-v136.quick_english: It is a fluid, black form, and it destroys wrinkles and gray hair.

kjn-p06-v137.quick_english: One should apply the cooling yoga at the location of the support region.

kjn-p06-v138.quick_english: One should see the sun as an enemy and the moon indeed as a friend.

kjn-p06-v139.quick_english: In an underground house or a solitary place, free from gnats and mosquitoes.

kjn-p06-v140.quick_english: In a secluded, deserted, divine place adorned with an abundance of flowers.

kjn-p06-v141.quick_english: After six months, perfection is attained, equal to the state of a yogini.

kjn-p06-v142.quick_english: O beautiful-faced one, situated from the brahma knot, these are indeed the three.

kjn-p06-v143.quick_english: O beloved, one should color everything, beginning with the hair pores, with the fluid.

kjn-p06-v144.quick_english: It indeed comes to pass without doubt within six months.

kjn-p06-v145.quick_english: It is fluid, black in color, and adorned with the sixteen vowels.

kjn-p06-v146.quick_english: Through six months of repeated practice, even an old person becomes youthful.

kjn-p06-v147.quick_english: Having resorted to the place of the yogini, one encounters a dark, black color.

kjn-p06-v148.quick_english: One should color the hair situated on the skull with its splendor.

kjn-p06-v149.quick_english: One becomes freed from old age and death, and devoid of disease and illness.

kjn-p06-v150.quick_english: The radiance situated in the cavity of the throat has gone to absorption in the brahma-aperture.

kjn-p07-v151.quick_english: Indeed, the good fortune of the bodiless one is a hidden junction-bond.

kjn-p07-v152.quick_english: In the first is the power to deceive people's speech; in the second is the destruction of pain.

kjn-p07-v153.quick_english: In the fourth is desirability of speech; in the fifth is hearing from a distance.

kjn-p07-v154.quick_english: And in the seventh, the state of meeting with the yoginis certainly arises.

kjn-p07-v155.quick_english: In the ninth is the state of fierce speed; in the tenth one becomes a holder of many forms.

kjn-p07-v156.quick_english: Endowed with the eleventh quality, this one is worshipped just as Shiva is worshipped.

kjn-p07-v157.quick_english: Therefore one should go wherever the mind delights.

kjn-p07-v158.quick_english: The scripture is free from elaboration, and the guru is free from elaboration.

kjn-p07-v159.quick_english: O Lord, O beloved, this is the Kaula tradition for those free from elaboration; for the bound being it is otherwise.

kjn-p07-v160.quick_english: Some have perished from ignorance, and some have perished from negligence.

kjn-p07-v161.quick_english: Trembling in agitation, and likewise anger, gesture, and leaping up.

kjn-p07-v162.quick_english: Whomever he touches with the hand, whomever he sees with the eye.

kjn-p07-v163.quick_english: O beloved of the yoginis, the knowledge of arresting grey hair has been declared.

kjn-p07-v164.quick_english: This secret determination of the knowledge of the transcendent mind has been declared to you.

kjn-p07-v165.quick_english: In the work emerged from Candradvipa, this is the seventh chapter.

kjn-p07-v166.quick_english: O Bhairava, how indeed was the divine Kula born within Akula?

kjn-p07-v167.quick_english: Is she innate-born or Kula-born? And what of the doctrine of the eight-times-eight?

kjn-p07-v168.quick_english: Tell me briefly the entire procedure for the worship of the guru.

kjn-p07-v169.quick_english: In a solitary, secluded place adorned with garlands of flowers.

kjn-p07-v170.quick_english: Furnished with food and eatables, and united with liquor and bliss.

kjn-p07-v171.quick_english: O great goddess, I shall tell you the separate distinction regarding the outcaste woman.

kjn-p07-v172.quick_english: They say the Kula-born is a courtesan; the outcaste woman is defined by her outcaste status.

kjn-p07-v173.quick_english: Through the practice involving the accessible and the inaccessible, it is characterized by the bliss of love.

kjn-p07-v174.quick_english: How is the Kula-born woman not known, she whose nature is of Kula beyond the multitude of castes?

kjn-p07-v175.quick_english: O goddess, listen: I shall declare the outcaste woman as she truly is.

kjn-p08-v176.quick_english: The great power, purified upward and sideways, is endowed with great splendor.

kjn-p08-v177.quick_english: The mouth is filled with betel and smeared with musk.

kjn-p08-v178.quick_english: There is a pair of vessels united with yoginis and heroes, placed separately, each apart.

kjn-p08-v179.quick_english: All are clad in red garments and resplendent with armlets and bracelets.

kjn-p08-v180.quick_english: Thus constituted, the kula teacher is attended by the sons of the kula.

kjn-p08-v181.quick_english: O fair-faced one, at Karavira, at Mahakala, and at Devikota.

kjn-p08-v182.quick_english: O beloved, among them, those who are born as field-born are indeed the chief.

kjn-p08-v183.quick_english: O lord of gods, the field-born are honored by siddhi throughout the four ages.

kjn-p08-v184.quick_english: O goddess, the field-born have been declared; now I shall tell you about the seat-born.

kjn-p08-v185.quick_english: Seven goddesses situated at the secondary seat dwell in the abode of the siddhas.

kjn-p08-v186.quick_english: Odiyana is the great seat, endowed with a secondary seat.

kjn-p08-v187.quick_english: O beloved, hear the method of worship for the deities of the seat and others.

kjn-p08-v188.quick_english: O auspicious one, when worshipped by these means, all the mothers grant success.

kjn-p08-v189.quick_english: O beloved, a mother is yoga-born through yoga, and mantra-born through mantra.

kjn-p08-v190.quick_english: Indeed, the divine sacred offering, when eaten, has an effect lasting for seven births, in relation to the animal.

kjn-p08-v191.quick_english: O lord of gods, one born in the womb knows the womb of one's own self.

kjn-p08-v192.quick_english: Varahi, thunderbolt-handed, and likewise Yogeshvari are named.

kjn-p08-v193.quick_english: Likewise, by them and by another door-guardian goddess, the world is indeed pervaded.

kjn-p08-v194.quick_english: One should daily worship all of them, endowed with the guru and the siddha.

kjn-p08-v195.quick_english: O beloved, I shall declare the group of eight and the method of eight times eight.

kjn-p08-v196.quick_english: As this is, so all should know the sequence of the yoginis.

kjn-p08-v197.quick_english: The yogini assembly circle consists of the eight powers beginning with anima.

kjn-p08-v198.quick_english: The second great circle is that which brings about the attraction of all.

kjn-p08-v199.quick_english: The third great circle is that which enables entering another's body.

kjn-p08-v200.quick_english: One indeed obtains whatever various thing is desired; there is no doubt.

kjn-p09-v201.quick_english: Having worshipped this circle, one applies meditation for as long as one continues the practice.

kjn-p09-v202.quick_english: Indeed, languages of various forms, both unheard and heard, become present.

kjn-p09-v203.quick_english: Indeed, by oneself they are heard by oneself, for oneself, and within oneself.

kjn-p09-v204.quick_english: Freed from wrinkles and grey hair, he becomes like a second Kāmadeva.

kjn-p09-v205.quick_english: One should destroy the wind and such forces by speech; then he indeed stands like a mute.

kjn-p09-v206.quick_english: O Goddess, the seventh circle is supreme, causing the paralysis of armies.

kjn-p09-v207.quick_english: Indeed, for one devoted to worship and meditation in that, there is vision from afar.

kjn-p09-v208.quick_english: O fortunate one, O beloved, killing, uprooting, paralyzing, deluding, and so forth are accomplished.

kjn-p09-v209.quick_english: Indeed, having known the method of eight times eight, one succeeds; not otherwise.

kjn-p09-v210.quick_english: Indeed, I have declared this without doubt; ascertain it with devotion and reasoning.

kjn-p09-v211.quick_english: In the work emerged from Candradvīpa, this is the eighth chapter.

kjn-p09-v212.quick_english: O beloved, I shall tell you the arrangement of the rows of yoginīs.

kjn-p09-v213.quick_english: This is the complete field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.

kjn-p09-v214.quick_english: All the innate ones, all those born of families, and all the door-guardians are included.

kjn-p09-v215.quick_english: Because of your devotion, the supreme secret of secrets has been revealed.

kjn-p09-v216.quick_english: Now I wish to hear from the gurus about the worship of the siddhas.

kjn-p09-v217.quick_english: One should give the arrangement of the two syllables to others.

kjn-p09-v218.quick_english: There is no knowledge equal to this, nor will there ever be again.

kjn-p09-v219.quick_english: O beautiful-eyed one, listen; I shall speak the method of their names.

kjn-p09-v220.quick_english: O Lord, thus are the independent impellers of the family in the four ages.

kjn-p09-v221.quick_english: Indeed, this Kaula teaching, supremely arisen, is ten crores in measure.

kjn-p09-v222.quick_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas and by supreme will, reaches up to Māyā.

kjn-p09-v223.quick_english: O Goddess, O beloved, it was told again to the Mothers by the sky-movers.

kjn-p09-v224.quick_english: O beloved, it was told to the earth-moving, good-eating yoginīs by an earth-mover.

kjn-p09-v225.quick_english: They are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.

kjn-p10-v226.quick_english: Enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment make one dear to the yoginīs.

kjn-p10-v227.quick_english: In candra dvīpa, the ninth chapter emerges.

kjn-p10-v228.quick_english: The self stands on one foot, surrounded by fire.

kjn-p10-v229.quick_english: The determination of knowledge is made manifest to me today, O god.

kjn-p10-v230.quick_english: The eightfold division is to be fully known in endless ways.

kjn-p10-v231.quick_english: As the secret place and wheel are quickly accomplished, O Bhairava.

kjn-p10-v232.quick_english: Well, well, O great goddess; I was asked what is hard to obtain even for gods.

kjn-p10-v233.quick_english: The syllable kṣa is brahmarandhra, and the syllable laṃ is in the forehead.

kjn-p10-v234.quick_english: The syllable ṣa is in the throat region, and the syllable śa is in the heart.

kjn-p10-v235.quick_english: The places and wheels are declared; hear their meditation, O beloved.

kjn-p10-v236.quick_english: The divine eight-spoked lotus is adorned by the first octad.

kjn-p10-v237.quick_english: Through practice with an equal mind, one should abandon village dharma.

kjn-p10-v238.quick_english: Knowledge from distant hearing removes bond and paralysis, O beloved.

kjn-p10-v239.quick_english: Immortality and transformation are stated in brief, O goddess.

kjn-p10-v240.quick_english: The second eight-petaled wheel is well illuminated by fire meditation.

kjn-p10-v241.quick_english: One whose mind is one-pointed in meditation makes many forms.

kjn-p10-v242.quick_english: When angry, he destroys all the triple world, moving and unmoving.

kjn-p10-v243.quick_english: The third great wheel is a liberator through nine tattvas.

kjn-p10-v244.quick_english: Wrinkles and grey hair are destroyed, and this is seen from very far.

kjn-p10-v245.quick_english: In solitude, make many forms and meditation, being intent on that.

kjn-p10-v246.quick_english: Indeed, constant practice makes immortality for one intent on it.

kjn-p10-v247.quick_english: By day, through non-eating, age and death will go away.

kjn-p10-v248.quick_english: Through constant yoga practice, one's form becomes sixteen years.

kjn-p10-v249.quick_english: Contemplating smoke color always shakes the triple world, O beloved.

kjn-p10-v250.quick_english: The sixth cakra, moreover, is the royal one, having eight petals and a pericarp.

kjn-p11-v251.quick_english: It includes knowledge of past and future, and indeed the eightfold qualities beginning with aṇimā.

kjn-p11-v252.quick_english: But the seventh, O great goddess, beloved, has the splendor of the full moon.

kjn-p11-v253.quick_english: It brings the destruction of old age and death, and entry into another's body.

kjn-p11-v254.quick_english: But the eighth is the great wheel, adorned with eight petals.

kjn-p11-v255.quick_english: In red meditation it always and necessarily brings about the supreme power of yellow paralyzing.

kjn-p11-v256.quick_english: By black, killing is declared; smoky is always for eradication.

kjn-p11-v257.quick_english: One should perform agitation in front, then further agitation, trembling, falling, and so on.

kjn-p11-v258.quick_english: O goddess, this meditation is established eightfold, for each one.
